# Rendered samples: Plain author–year citations

| Citation | Main (Enter) | Alternate (Shift+Enter) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Journal article | `(Ioannidis 2005)` | `Ioannidis (2005)` |
| Conference paper | `(Rivera and Chen 2026)` | `Rivera and Chen (2026)` |
| Book | `(Kahneman 2011)` | `Kahneman (2011)` |
| Thesis | `(Batista 2010)` | `Batista (2010)` |
| Book chapter | `(Tversky and Kahneman 1982)` | `Tversky and Kahneman (1982)` |
| Letter | `(Aldous 1887)` | `Aldous (1887)` |
| Manuscript | `(Aldous 1885)` | `Aldous (1885)` |
| Interview | `(Okafor 2019)` | `Okafor (2019)` |
| Document | `(Brackenridge Free Library 1923)` | `Brackenridge Free Library (1923)` |
| Journal article with four authors | `(Klein et al. 2014)` | `Klein et al. (2014)` |
| Report whose title holds characters a file name cannot | `(Lee 2021)` | `Lee (2021)` |
| Web page with no author, date, or citation key | `(Open access: Frequently asked questions n.d.)` | `Open access: Frequently asked questions (n.d.)` |
| Journal article and book | `(Ioannidis 2005; Kahneman 2011)` | `Ioannidis (2005); Kahneman (2011)` |
| Journal article, pages 12-14 | `(Ioannidis 2005, p. 12-14)` | `Ioannidis (2005, p. 12-14)` |
| Journal article, author left out | `(2005)` | `(2005)` |
| Journal article, with text before and after | `(see Ioannidis 2005 for a review)` | `see Ioannidis (2005) for a review` |
| Journal article, page 1, as an annotation cites it | `(Ioannidis 2005, p. 1)` | `Ioannidis (2005, p. 1)` |
